filmy.tytul: Blue Mold – Glass Between Us (Official Music Video)
filmy.opis: Somewhere between the stars, two people share nothing but a quarantine window, a finger's width of glass and the fear of what might be growing on either side. A fragile acoustic ballad that shatters into metal, about loneliness, love and the hope of one more touch.
